an8.31:1.3: (1) Having insulted the recipient, one gives a gift.
an8.31:1.4: (2) One gives a gift from fear.
an8.31:1.5: (3) One gives a gift, thinking: ‘He gave to me.’
an8.31:1.6: (4) One gives a gift, thinking: ‘He will give to me.’ (5) One gives a gift, thinking:
an8.31:1.7: ‘Giving is good.’ (6) One gives a gift, thinking:
an8.31:1.8: ‘I cook; these people do not cook. It isn’t right that I who cook should not give to those who do not cook.’
an8.31:1.9: (7) One gives a gift, thinking: ‘Because I have given this gift, I will gain a good reputation.’
an8.31:1.10: (8) One gives a gift for the purpose of ornamenting the mind, equipping the mind.”
